full_judgment: 11. Unaided by the Bar a decision. Bishakha Gupta vs. Bepin Behari PLD 1957 Dhaka 548, by a Division Bench has come to our notice which may be said to support the view of Mr. Pal. It was an appeal arising out of the judgment and decree of refusal to grant Letters of Administration to the plaintiff by the Subordinate Judge. Jessore in Testamentary Suit No. 26 of 1953. Initially the matter was pending before the District Delegate but finally the suit was transferred to the Subordinate Judge.
